records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Professional services revenue decreased in Q1’23 from Q1’22 as we continue to execute on our strategy of leveraging partners to deliver services rather than contracting to deliver services ourselves, including the Q3'22 sale of a portion of our PLM services business to ITC Infotech.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For both Windchill and IIoT, the average duration of on-premises subscriptions starting in the period decreased from Q1'22 to Q1'23, resulting in a reduction of on-premises subscription revenue recognized in Q1’23.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Software revenue growth in Q1’23 was negatively impacted by the value of foreign currencies compared to the U.S. Dollar.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: License gross margin increased in Q1’23 compared to Q1’22 due to a $3.6 million increase in license revenue, partially offset by a $3.0 million increase in cost of license revenue, which was driven by higher royalty expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Free cash flow of $172 million in Q1'23 increased from $134 million in Q1'22, which includes capital expenditures of $9 million in Q1'23 and $3 million in Q1'22.
